mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_code (phone, code, scene, expire_time, used, send_ip, user_agent, status, remark) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{scene}, #{expireTime}, 0, #{sendIp}, #{userAgent}, 1, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, code, scene, expire_time, used, used_time, send_ip, user_agent, status, remark, create_time FROM sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND scene = #{scene} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, phone, code, scene, expire_time, used, used_time, send_ip, user_agent, status, remark, create_time FROM sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND scene = #{scene} AND used = 0 AND status = 1 AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_code SET status = 0 WHERE phone = #{phone} AND scene = #{scene} AND used = 0 AND status = 1
UPDATE sms_code SET used = 1, used_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND used = 0 AND status = 1
